movie review: threads (1984)this is essential viewing for every prepper and survivalist, regardless of your experience and ability. threads is a genuine horror movie covering shtf. the scenario is what would happen if the uk was affected by a nuclear war?the writers of this movie went to insane levels with the research that was poured in to this film. it would be impossible for me to cover the absolute wealth of information that it delivers, but i will mention a few points that jumped out for me:having adequate clothing that protects you from the weather is your most basic prep. even if you have no gear whatsoever, if you at least are protected from the elements then you may get an opportunity later to find more gearcarrying even a few basic tools like a pocket knife, a lighter, and a torch, would seem like an absolute gift from god in a shtf scenarioin the film, the first thing that the government did in the lead up to the nuclear attack was to lock up  problematic  people. one character was very good at organising protests. the film goes to some pains to show that he doesn t believe in violence, but the government didn t care   he was a guy who was known to organise people so for that reason he was imprisoned.the escape routes were quickly cut off with check points. some characters could see that a nuclear attack was going to happen any day now, so they tried to flee the city. however, they were blocked by police and military who sent them home.having access to information is important. a lot of the characters suffered because they didn t know what had happened to family and friends, they didn t know what the government was up to, they didn t know what areas they should avoid.electronics stopped working. this included cars. what this meant was that some people were stranded because they expected to flee in their vehicle. in summary, this film is a work of genius. it not only functions as a disturbing horror movie, it is also an invaluable education on shtf.

interview with an it security expertimagine a dystopian society where the police are constantly scanning private citizens social media and then imprisoning them with the harshest of sentences just for expressing opinions.in such a nightmare scenario where free speech is effectively outlawed, what can a normal citizen do to remove their digital footprint?this is a question i posed to a person who works at a high level in it security. i ll share the insights i learned here:there are essentially 2 types of records of your online activity, the one that your internet provider has, and the information stored on your physical device (laptop, phone, etc).to remove the data from the internet provider it is best to simply contact them and ask for your data to be removed. the gdpr laws (privacy laws) in europe can work well in your favour here. if for some reason they won t remove your info, then you can at least ask them what information they have on you.to remove data from a physical device such as a phone, firstly bear in mind that the data is always there, no matter what you do to try to erase it. therefore you want to grind the device to dust, or something else that will destroy it completely.if someone is actively pursuing you, such as a law enforcement agency, then they will already have whatever information your internet provider has. in such a dystopian society as the one described at the start it would be wise to conduct all business face to face and to go  underground  at least as far as your online presence goes.

tips for a much faster bolt actioni ll share with you some neat tricks to make your bolt action rifle significantly smoother and faster, but do pay attention to the safety advice.first of all, you want to degrease the bolt. i use bore tech products for this entire tutorial -i have no affiliation with any company nor do i get paid to recommend anyone, i have just found bore tech to be good.once the bolt is degreased and is clean and has no lint or debris then place the bolt in the oven for a few minutes. yes, you read that right. you re just looking to heat the metal up gently so it will be more receptive to the treatments it is about to receive. the bolt doesn t need to be too hot -you should still be able to pick it up with your bare hands.next, you want to apply bore tech friction guard. this will go all over the body of the bolt, but we want to avoid applying any over the bolt face. this is because the liquid may get in to the firing pin and may cause some problems there, for example if the firing pin jams in place then later when you go to cycle the bolt you may cause a slam fire. this is a situation you obviously want to avoid.dab the excess friction guard from the bolt, and then next you want to apply bore tech extreme grease to the bolt lugs. you want to particularly pay attention to the tops and sides of the bolts. remove all excess grease. you shouldn t see any grease left over.important: you do not want to get grease or lubricant in the bolt face or inside the firing pin. this may cause the firing pin to jam, which may have very serious results.once you have done all that you will see an immediate improvement in the smoothness and speed of the bolt. this will make it much easier to cycle the bolt rapidly and with little effort. this entire process only needs to be done once every few years.
